english: Velasenule gaganaana thoorpu thaara – nisidhi reyi jaamulo
christmas kaanthule lokaana veligene – prabhuyese janminchagaa
kanyaku putte nedu parshuddhude – dheenulu dhanyulaayane

intro: Velasenule is the latest Telugu Christmas song written by Sunil Thurimella, sung by Sharon Sisters featuring Sharon Philip, Lillian Christopher, Hana Joyce, tune by Lillian Christopher and music by JK Christopher. This song video was released on November 15, 2023 through Sharon Sisters YouTube channel.
